rules.message: The field needs a hidden identity input — the visible code is presentation; the hidden id is what the form submits.
The code input validates on change (data-hx-get + data-hx-trigger="change") — a code the server never saw must not sit under a filled id.
Resolve responses re-render the WHOLE field (data-hx-swap="outerHTML") — code, hint, and hidden id must change together or they drift apart.
The search button should declare aria-haspopup="dialog" and be type="button" so it never submits the surrounding form.
